paragraphs.text: See 1Ki 2:10.
paragraphs.anchor: So Abijah slept with his fathers.

paragraphs.text: There David’s sepulchre was to be seen in the apostles’ days; {Act 2:29} and there Solomon’s sepulchre, which the Jews had in great esteem, fell to pieces without force offered to it, a little before the last destruction of Jerusalem in 132 AD, as Dio testifieth. {a}
See 1Ki 15:11.
paragraphs.anchor: And Asa did that which was good.

paragraphs.text: Not in his own eyes, or the eyes of men, qui larvis ducuntur, which are oft bemisted.
paragraphs.anchor: In the eyes of the Lord.

paragraphs.text: Erected to idols; not the other. {1Ki 15:14}
It is not enough to pull down superstition; but God’s sincere service also must be set up.
Heb., The sun images: Hammonim, the images of Jupiter Ammon, as some {a} will have it.
{a} A Lapide.
Though he had no war, yet he provided for it. So did our Queen Elizabeth; and so must every Christian soldier.
It did his heart good to think how piously they had purchased their present peace; and therefore he repeateth it. See Zec 8:19. {See Trapp on "Zec 8:19"}
paragraphs.anchor: Because we have sought the Lord our God, we have sought him.

paragraphs.text: "Little Benjamin" was grown very numerous and potent.
Called in, likely, by the ten tribes, in revenge of the late overthrow given them by Abijah.
paragraphs.anchor: And there came out against them.

paragraphs.text: Who is thought to have reigned over Egypt also.
A larger host than that of Xerxes. Josephus saith it consisted of nine hundred thousand foot, and one hundred thousand horse.
paragraphs.anchor: With a host of a thousand thousand.

paragraphs.text: sc., Falcatis et aeratis, armed with scythes, and other instruments of death.
The country of the prophet Micah, the Morasthite, in the tribe of Judah. Here, then, was Hannibal ad portas.
See Jdg 1:17.
See 1Sa 14:9.
Adiuva nos, nam te nitimur: Asa found his great army outmatched, and therefore resteth wholly upon God, and sped accordingly, as Hanani afterwards mindeth him. {2Ch 16:8}
paragraphs.anchor: Help us, O Lord our God; for we rest on thee.

paragraphs.text: i.e., For thy service and glory, by thy will, under thy conduct, calling upon thy name, and resting on thy power.
Sorry, sickly man, as the word signifieth.
paragraphs.anchor: Let not man prevail against thee.

paragraphs.text: Egit in praecipitiurn, he tumbled them down headlong.
paragraphs.anchor: So the Lord smote the Ethiopians.

paragraphs.text: A city of the Philistines, who took part, it is likely, with these Ethiopians, and therefore suffered with them.
Heb., There was no life in them; pecoris instar trucidabantur, they were slain as dogs.
paragraphs.anchor: That they could not recover themselves.

paragraphs.text: His host of angels, saith Lyra
A good amends for the treasure that Shishak, king of Egypt and Ethiopia, took from Rehoboam. Riches come and go, accedunt et recedunt instar Euripi, they do often change masters.
paragraphs.anchor: And they carried away very much spoil.

paragraphs.text: See on 2Ch 14:13.
paragraphs.anchor: And they smote all the cities.

paragraphs.text: The Arabian Scenites, who had also aided the Ethiopians, and now had enough of it. "So let all thine enemies perish, O Lord."
paragraphs.anchor: They smote also the tents of cattle.
